Name: JP's Le Pets - Monster Girls
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][center]﻿[color=#00ff00][u]Monster Girls[/u][/color][/center][/i][/b][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i][b][center]Add several familiar and not so familiar faces in the form of
monster girls that you can adopt at Marnie's Ranch. [/center][/b][/i][/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][u][b][i]This mod contains:[/i]
[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[/font][size=4][font=Georgia][list=1]
[*]Enjoy several familiar and not so familiar faces turned into monster girls with a set of adorable animations. 
[*][b][color=#00ff00]All can be obtained at Marnie's Ranch for 10000 gold.[/color] You can also select one of these pets when creating a new character. [/b]
[*]From a relationship with your pets greater than 1 heart, there is a daily probability of 30% that they will give you a gift when you pet them. The more hearts, the better the gifts. [b]The gifts are related to the objects that the villagers like the most, on which these monsters are based. (Amethyst from Abigail, Pizza from Samy, Sunflower from Haley, etc.)[/b]
[*]All the girls have a new set of adorable animations that they will perform randomly throughout the day.
[*]At the moment you can meet and adopt the following monster girls: 
[/list][/font][font=Georgia][list=1]
[/list][/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Abigail the Cat (Purple or black hair)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Chibs the Cat (A mini-Abigail)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Leah the Fox (Orange or red hair)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Haley the Squirrel (Blonde or brown hair)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Maru the Owl [/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Penny the Bunny[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Emily the Peacock (xD)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Samy the demon (From the Girls of the Valley mod. Blonde or Pink hair)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Shannon the wolf (From the Girls of the Valley mod. Purple or Gray hair)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=6][b][u][i]In order to adopt you must do one of these two options:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Reach 5 hearts with the pet Marnie finds.[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]Rejects the pet Marnie finds [/color]and[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b] wait until day 2 of year 2 to receive a letter from her. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][color=#ff0000][b][size=4][b][i][color=#00ffff]Not much more to add, I hope you like it. [/color][/i][/b][/size]
